hjorth_filter: Butterworth order 4, zero-phase sosfiltfilt, whole 10 s window

feature_rules.A: Welch PSD; least squares log10(PSD) ~ log10(f) on 2-40 Hz excluding 7-14 Hz; exponent=-slope, offset=intercept; alpha peak = argmax of log10 residual over 7-14 Hz (freq and residual power)
feature_rules.B: Shannon entropy of PSD normalized to sum 1 over 1-45 Hz, divided by log(n_bins)
feature_rules.C: Hjorth mobility and complexity on 1-45 Hz band-passed window
feature_rules.D: 001 cache asymmetry_* (12 pairs x 5 bands, left minus right log power)

normalization: per subject/user unlabeled zscore for every feature block
decision: pre-registered: accept a method only if repeat-mean AUC gain >= +0.005 vs control_600 AND repeat-mean F1 not lower AND repeat-mean DEP AUC not lower AND fixed002 AUC gain > 0; otherwise stop, no tuning
p2_diagnostic: descriptive only, training labels: per-subject Cohen d (pos minus neg, pooled sd) per new feature; mean |d| by HC/DEP; direction consistency = fraction of subjects whose sign(d) equals sign of all-subject mean d
